page.layout: One page of running text, one column, full width. No margin notes. Below the last line, at the right, a catchword. Faint marks at the bottom left, not printed text.

l.i: cedi debet & est verissimum, Non sa-
tisfecisse officio qui se ingessit, ni fece-
rit quod debuit: satisfecisse qui admonitus
inciam hanc quo concilio jam olim
to quadriennio nil gestum fit, si forte
ter Kal. Sextiles:) discessi tum hinc
ea mente, ut proximo termino Michae-
lis certo etiam die constituto, Kal. &c.[?]

page.notes: Catchword "curarem" is the first word of the next page and is kept out of the text. Line-end hyphens are joined: "sa-tisfecisse", "pro-vinciam", "to-to", "Michae-lis", "do-mesticas". "Quo" is underlined in the print; underline is not italic, so no tag is used. "Kal. &c." is read from "sc." and marked [?]. The first word "cedi" is a fragment from the previous page and stays as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Faint marks at the bottom left are stains or a signature, not transcribed.
